reason: B offers the more specific and novel test by combining negative-enthalpy-enabled local chemical ordering with cryo-rolling and flash annealing, using a matched conventional-annealing baseline and direct APT/TEM verification; A largely repackages established heterogeneous-microstructure processing and applies it too broadly across dissimilar HEAs. Both proposals weakly justify improvements in Young’s modulus and omit explicit high-temperature test conditions, but B’s strength–ductility mechanism is better grounded and more decisively testable.
